frozen_threshold.selection_data: Exactly 100 training-seed OOF predictions using native B100 labels

original_frozen_threshold.selection_data: Only 100 seed-held-out predictions from the original B100 training roster

execution_diagnosis.description: Proposal, veto and stay counts are uncapped totals on each controller's own trajectory. Accepted model overrides and executed phase switches are distinct counts.

interpretation: The no-stay versus V154Q comparison holds model, threshold, source and network fixed. Complete colliding runs remain in service means; invalid runs disable means. Seed41242 was used for geometry development, and the additional-two-seed summary is prespecified. The stay ablation was selected after inspecting failures on these seeds and is development evidence.

conclusion.mechanism: Removing only model stay overrides eliminates executed stay overrides and the recorded prolonged-green collapse in all three seeds; longest continuous green is20/26/20 seconds.
conclusion.service: Service recovers substantially from V154Q in every seed, but waiting and system vehicle hours remain higher than both PhasePressure and the original V154M thresholded controller in every seed.
conclusion.remaining_gap: No-stay waiting is21.87% abovePP and system vehicle hours13.48% abovePP; the unchanged numerical threshold0 was calibrated before this deployment veto was introduced.

limitations: The stay veto was selected after observing these development trajectories; it is not independent confirmation.
The ablation identifies a major source of the observed service collapse, without correcting the model switch-ranking error already seen in V154R.
Proposal counts are measured on each resulting trajectory, not at matched states between policies.

next_step.purpose: Calibrate the remaining model-switch proposals under the deployed no-stay rule using only the original100 training-seed OOF predictions.
next_step.fixed_rule: Align all100 OOF groups and candidate phases to the absolute native bank. If the original top1 differs fromPP and its absolute switch_indicator is0, fall back toPP. Keep all100 groups in seed-cost denominators; neither delete vetoed groups nor reselect a second-best switching action.
next_step.threshold_selection: Reuse the V154L selection rule: PP-only,zero,and positive retained-proposal advantage cutpoints; minimize equal-seed native450s cost; ties prefer PP-only then the highest threshold.
next_step.stop_rule: If PP-only is selected, report that no beneficial switch threshold was supported by this calibration; do not force a positive model-override policy.
next_step.proposal_accounting: For the chosen threshold, count threshold rejections first, then stay vetoes among threshold-accepted proposals, matching S deployment order.
